description: Delete address and all its entries. Archives associated memory.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Delete confirmation with keys: message (confirmation of deletion)
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Permanently deletes an address and all its entries, archiving the associated memory record
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFoundError: no address exists with the given name. DatabaseError: deletion failed due to storage issues. MemoryServiceError: memory archival failed but address may be deleted.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For not found: the address may have already been deleted, or use 'search' to find the correct name. For database errors: suggest retrying the operation. For memory errors: address is deleted, memory may need manual cleanup.
